source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of functions and modules (PDF 46).

blocks.text: Functions aur modules se Python ka code efficient (kam mehnat wala) aur organized (tarteeb wala) banta hai. Function code ke aise hisse ko ek naam de deta hai jo baar baar istemal ho sake. Module ek file hai jo milte julte functions ko ek jagah rakh kar program ko structure deti hai (tarteeb se rakhti hai).

blocks.prompt: Module function se kaise alag hai?
blocks.explanation: Function code ka ek naam wala, dobara istemal hone wala block hai; module aisi file hai jis mein kai related (aapas mein jure) functions (aur variables aur classes) ho sakte hain.

items: Function: naam wala, dobara chalne wala code; module: functions ki file.
